s.how: Rub a pot with garlic, heat 300ml white wine, then stir in 400g grated gruyère and emmental tossed in 1 tbsp cornflour until smooth. Serve with cubes of crusty bread.
Roll 500g pizza dough flat, spread with pizza sauce and top with 100g pepperoni and 150g mozzarella. Roll up, slice and bake at 200C for 18 minutes.

m.how: Brown 800g beef mince with an onion and 2 tbsp chilli powder. Add 400g tomatoes and 2 tins kidney beans and simmer 40 minutes. Serve with sour cream and cheese.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter, whisk in 300g sugar and 3 eggs, fold in 100g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 28 minutes and dust with icing sugar.

d.note: the Russian energy drink spilled on the controls
d.how: Mix the juice of 3 lemons and 2 oranges with 3 tbsp sugar and grated ginger. Top with 1L soda water over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
